places.name: Girona Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A magnificent cathedral with a mix of Romanesque and Gothic styles, featuring the widest Gothic nave in the world.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during religious services.

places.address: Plaça de la Catedral, s/n, 17004 Girona, Spain
